summary: Introduces plugins as code that augments Ansible's core functionality through a plugin architecture, noting Ansible ships many plugins and you can write your own.
questions: Can I write my own Ansible plugins?

answer_card.title: What plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Plugins are pieces of code that augment Ansible's core functionality; Ansible uses a plugin architecture for a flexible, expandable feature set. It ships with many plugins of various types, and you can write your own.
